title: Experience
description: A path that runs between hotel operations and technology. Filter by area to explore each part of my experience.

entries.summary: An apart-hotel with 33 apartments in Girona. I work on the day-to-day running of the property: reservations, availability, guest service, distribution, pricing and coordination of incidents and operational needs.
highlights: Guest support in person, by email and by phone, in several languages
Channel management: Booking.com, Expedia and direct sales
Design and development of my own internal tool to manage arrivals, message templates, quotes and housekeeping.

entries.role: Development and maintenance of my own product
entries.summary: A real web product in production for a professional photographer, with a public site, content management, image infrastructure and admin tools. I have been building and maintaining it since 2024.
highlights: A production product whose content the client manages herself
Architecture evolution: from Vue + Node/Express + MySQL to Next.js, React and Supabase
Media storage migrated from Cloudinary to Cloudflare R2
Multi-language site and a custom admin dashboard

entries.summary: Front office at a high-occupancy holiday hotel, handling a steady volume of arrivals, departures, reservations and incidents.
highlights: Guest support in person, by email and by phone

entries.summary: Front office in high season, looking after both individual guests and groups in a high-occupancy setting.
highlights: Multilingual support for individual guests and groups
Payments, invoicing, POS and cash reconciliation

entries.summary: Redesign and improvement of a live commercial site, working directly with the client.
highlights: Redesign of a WordPress site in production, without taking it offline
Testing, troubleshooting and improvements driven by real business needs

entries.summary: Corporate reception in an international environment linked to the MotoGP World Championship, looking after executives, sponsors, suppliers, press and international visitors across several seasons.
highlights: Support for executives, sponsors, suppliers and international press

entries.summary: Web development internship within the engineering team, alongside corporate reception.
highlights: Development with HTML, CSS and JavaScript
